If sentiment is negative (≤0.0) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to align with downward momentum.

If sentiment is positive (≥0.67) and forecast is above 72.0, cap mid-horizon (8–15 days) forecast at 72.0 to avoid overestimating bullish run.

If sentiment is neutral (0.0–0.33) and forecast is trending upward, reduce late-horizon (16–30 days) by 0.5–1.0% to reflect diminishing momentum.

If sentiment is positive but recent prices are falling, shift forecast downward by 0.8–1.2% in mid-horizon to counteract sentiment bias.

If sentiment is negative and forecast is below 70.0, increase late-horizon by 0.5–1.0% to offset pessimism-driven underestimation.

If sentiment is positive and forecast is above 74.0, reduce forecast by 1.0–1.5% in late-horizon to prevent overcorrection from bullish sentiment.
